name: Pricing agent charges the exact coupon amount
description: Golden case recorded from an early version of the pricing agent. tool_trajectory_avg_score pins down exactly which tool call it expects; the TOOL_USE_QUALITY rubric states the actual requirement in words instead of a literal tool name.

parts.text: A customer's cart total is $19.99 and they have a 15% loyalty coupon. What do we charge them?
After the 15% loyalty coupon, charge the customer $17.00.

rubric_content.text_property: When an available tool is documented as computing the exact amount actually charged to a customer, the agent uses that tool rather than a tool documented as an estimate or preview, for any number that will appear on an invoice or charge.
